headline: Staging bucket created but no upload mechanism configured — browsers cannot use it

findings.evidence_ref: New resource aws_s3_bucket.tmp_uploads with no bucket policy, CORS configuration, or IAM permissions defined
findings.explanation: The PR description states browser uploads should land in this bucket, but the diff shows no configuration for how browsers will actually upload to it. Without a bucket policy or CORS setup, uploads will fail and the staging workflow cannot work.
